active_assumptions.intent: Consumer accepts valid data within four cycles.

property_intent: Liveness should use the same four-cycle fairness bound as the environment.

assertion_intent.broken_sva: p_eventual_pop_too_fast_bad: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) pop_valid |-> ##[0:1] pop_fire);
assertion_intent.reference_sva: p_eventual_pop: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) pop_valid |-> ##[0:4] pop_fire);

root_cause: The assertion is stricter than the valid fairness assumption and reports legal two-to-four-cycle stalls as failures.
